changes: Portable extension ZIP packaging with an explicit asset allowlist, GPL license and modification notice
Regression coverage for builds without npm or zip executables, asset integrity and stale output exclusion
Repository, issue tracker and homepage metadata target asumaroks; original authorship retained

Tab sharing from the Chrome page context menu via a new /share plugin endpoint, plus README and privacy policy updates; cross-origin requests carrying an http(s) Origin are rejected with 403 on both /annotation and /share
Screenshots sent from the extension no longer contain the extension's own overlays for tab share and annotation
